targets.title: Impact of APOE on the healthy aging brain: a voxel-based MRI and DTI study.
targets.evidence_quote: The current study aimed to replicate and expand the multimodal approach employed by Honea et al.
targets.outcome_quote: The current study partially replicated and extended previous findings from an earlier multimodal study (Honea 2009).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors give an overall partial-replication verdict: structural null results replicated, cognitive differences did not. The conclusion confirming main imaging findings is restricted to those findings, not an overall verdict overriding the explicit cognitive contrast.
